justification: Standard: deletes 8 unused files that carried hand-typed planning figures, shrinking the figure ledger from 546 to 515 open.

pre_impl.existing_data: No database change of any kind; only source files are deleted.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: None: grep found no importer of any deleted module outside the deleted files themselves.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Deletion only; no new code, module or route is added.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any remaining file still imports a deleted module (tsc or pytest collection breaks), or the ledger lists figures in files that no longer exist.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before pruning, --check reported the deleted files' entries as GONE; after --prune it reports 0 unlisted and 515 open. tsc 0 errors; pytest collects 9,371 tests with no import errors.

functions.name: scan (lint_hardcoded_regulatory_numbers)
functions.input: the repository source tree after the deletion
functions.output: 0 unlisted figures and 515 open, down from 546
functions.if_none: if a deleted file were still listed the check reports it as GONE and fails

break_it.scenario: A dynamic import or string path still loads one of the deleted modules at run time.
break_it.what_happens: The caller would fail when it runs.
break_it.how: grep for each module name across py/ts/tsx, Dockerfiles, toml, yml and json found only history docs and the ledger

break_it.scenario: A Python test file still imports a deleted service module.
break_it.what_happens: pytest collection would error and CI would go red.
break_it.how: the two root_tests that imported authoritative_setback_calculator were deleted with it; pytest collects 9,371 with no errors
tsc --noEmit reports 0 errors after the deletion

post_merge.manual_verify: None needed; no deleted file was imported.
